name: Brad Hiruma
source: Brad is the director and a doctor in a hospital known for its use of lots of equipment and low fees, making it very popular among the citizens. Though polite, he gives off a very cold impression and an atmosphere that makes people want to keep their distance from him. He used to be a cheerful person with lots of friends in the past, but now he has a very closed off personality.
